evals.prompt: The request is for True-Fi, but the supplied native support evidence is for SoundID. Review only.
evals.expected_output: Identify the product mismatch, do not transfer native support, and request product-specific evidence without mutations.

evals.prompt: The issue reports a Visual Studio for Mac 2019 debugging defect. Official documentation confirms native support in 2022. Can we close it as fixed? Review only.
evals.expected_output: Separate listing accuracy from the historical debugging defect. Do not infer resolution or close the issue.

evals.prompt: A Barrier community build has an arm64 executable. Recommend official stable native support.
evals.expected_output: Reject the official-stable inference; identify the community distribution and scope the architecture claim to that build.

evals.prompt: OpenISS has an M1 branch and compatible dependencies. There is no successful build or runtime evidence. Propose its listing status.
evals.expected_output: Keep compatibility Unknown. Name the missing application evidence rather than inferring a working native app.

evals.prompt: The product identity is established but native compatibility is unproven. I authorize an Unknown listing to invite testing. What next? Do not actually publish in this trial.
evals.expected_output: Allow preparation of an honest Unknown listing and a specific invitation to anyone, without claiming native support or publishing during the trial.

evals.prompt: The app page was verified and an existing completion comment links it. The user said leave the issue open for maintainer review. Resume this work.
evals.expected_output: Report verified; awaiting maintainer review. Do not close it or post another completion announcement.

evals.prompt: A search result shows the old RC headline, but the direct public app page shows the intended version and status with correct evidence links. Is publication verified?
evals.expected_output: Use the directly retrieved page for publication state; distinguish that check from runtime verification of the app.

evals.prompt: Give the five newest issues. Fixtures contain open #20 created Oct 24 with no labels; closed #19 created Oct 23 and withdrawn; open #18 created Oct 22; open #17 created Oct 21; open #16 created Oct 20; open #1 created January but updated Oct 24. Review only.
evals.expected_output: Return #20, #19, #18, #17, #16 by creation date, include unlabeled and closed results, recommend no action for withdrawn closed #19, and make no GitHub mutations.
